instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/selection.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. blocker (line 220): Root cause of both failing UI tests is in the test, not in lasso/utils.ts or lasso/index.ts. The test renders <Excalidraw/> under jsdom where appState.width/height are 0, so app.visibleElements (which LassoTrail.updateSelection passes as both 'elements' and the source of elementsSegments) contains only rect1 (touching the origin); rect2 at x=100 is culled and can never be selected in any mode. Confirmed with a throwaway debug test: visibleElements = [rect1] on every pointermove, state.width = state.height = 0. lasso.test.tsx avoids this with h.state.width/height = 1000 in its beforeEach. The densify helper added in the fix round was based on a wrong diagnosis (simplify(…, 5) does not collapse the corners). — fix: Give the editor a viewport before drawing: add API.setAppState({ width: 1000, height: 1000 }); as the first statement of createScene (before API.setElements). Verified: with that line and the plan's plain 5-point lasso, all three cases pass (contain -> [rect1], switch-to-overlap -> [rect1, rect2], overlap -> [rect1, rect2]).
2. major (line 245): Deviation from change_plan U04 rule 4: the fix round added a densify() helper with an incorrect comment ('one pointermove per corner gets collapsed by path simplification') and changed the lasso's closing point to (-20, -15). Neither is needed once the viewport is sized, and the comment misdocuments the lasso util. — fix: Delete the densify helper and its comment; define the lasso as lassoSelect([[-20, -20], [125, -20], [125, 70], [-20, 70], [-20, -20]]) exactly as the plan states (line 264 onward), keeping the one-line comment that rect1 is enclosed and rect2 is only partially covered.
3. major (line 284): 'wrap (contain) > selects only the fully enclosed element' currently passes vacuously: rect2 is never in visibleElements (0x0 viewport), so the assertion [rect1] does not prove that Wrap mode rejects the partially touched rect2 (AC-1). — fix: Resolved by the same createScene viewport fix above; no separate change needed beyond it, but the test must be re-run after that fix to confirm it still asserts [rect1] with rect2 visible (it does in the debug run).

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/selection.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
